name: The Shops At Thirteen Forty Five
summary: The Shops at Thirteen Forty Five is Palm Springs' premier design collective featuring curated boutiques specializing in mid-century modern furniture, vintage jewelry, art, and unique home décor. This distinctive destination offers design enthusiasts a carefully selected mix of individual shops showcasing authentic vintage and contemporary pieces that embody the desert modernism aesthetic.
demographics: The Shops at Thirteen Forty Five attracts an affluent, design-conscious demographic with a strong appreciation for mid-century modern aesthetics and vintage collectibles. The primary visitor base consists of homeowners aged 35-65 with above-average household incomes, including interior designers, architects, and collectors seeking unique furnishings and art pieces. The trade area draws from Palm Springs' year-round residents as well as seasonal visitors and second-home owners who are typically well-educated professionals with disposable income for high-end home décor and vintage items. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for curated, one-of-a-kind pieces rather than mass-market goods, with visitors often making planned trips specifically to browse the specialized boutiques.
description: The Shops at Thirteen Forty Five stands as Palm Springs' original premier design collective, offering a carefully curated destination for discerning shoppers seeking unique treasures. Located at 1345 North Palm Canyon Drive in the heart of Palm Springs, this distinctive shopping center has established itself as the go-to destination for mid-century modern and contemporary interior décor enthusiasts. The center features an eclectic mix of individual boutiques specializing in vintage studio jewelry, costume jewelry, modern furniture, and unique garden sculptures that perfectly complement the desert modernism aesthetic Palm Springs is famous for. Each shop within the collective offers a diverse selection of art and home furnishings, creating an immersive shopping experience for design lovers and collectors alike. With its focus on quality over quantity and authenticity over mass production, The Shops at Thirteen Forty Five has become an essential stop for anyone looking to capture the sophisticated, retro-modern spirit that defines Palm Springs style.
